reuse.why: All providers share the new link validation and reuse findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, but Fintegra copies existing linking and download workflows.

duplication.why: The diff adds copies of the account-link workflow, transaction downloader, and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Link policy, transaction downloading, server configuration, and provider types remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: The edits directly support the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, including minimal client updates for the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: Centralized validation makes rule changes manageable, but copied provider workflows and separate unlink reset definitions create avoidable maintenance obligations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers call assertBankAccountLinkable; unlinkAccount includes provider cleanup and is not an appropriate abstraction for local-only replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra workflows and unlink reset are straightforward copies with provider substitutions, rather than logic concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountLinkable gains the replaceExistingLink parameter, a replacement exception to duplicate refusal, and closed-target validation; all six providers continue through it.
